verdict.rationale: PayPal docs confirm a single integration (PayPal Checkout/Expanded Checkout) covering wallets (PayPal, Venmo), digital wallets like Apple Pay/Google Pay/Samsung Pay, Pay Later/BNPL (Pay in 4), and card/local funding sources, plus Fastlane for guest recognition — all through the same REST API/checkout stack rather than separate integrations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bank redirect methods (e.g., iDEAL, SEPA) and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
